page.overview:
Who is Aelidas?

Aelidas is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

After Mazrim Taim declared himself as a False Dragon, Aelidas was selected as the head of the mission to capture and gentle him. Unbeknownst to her, the Black Ajah severely infiltrated the Red's delegation, and tried to use the opportunity to free Taim in the name of the Shadow.
